title: Track your Claude Code usage | LangWatch
excerpt: Full trace history for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor, and Pi. Tokens by class including cache reads, and theoretical spend on bundled plans.
content_html:
Or Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor and Pi. Capture full trace history to improve your flow, and track how much you're spending in tokens.

Start tracking right away:

Features

Everything a session leaves behind, in the platform's own UI.

Cache hit tracking

Cache reads and writes are separate token classes on every span, down to the 5m and 1h TTL split on writes.

Token accounting

Theoretical vs billed costs

Exact cost numbers, straight from the API response. See how much you would be spending if you weren’t on an individual or team plan.

Open cost analytics

Tools, skills, MCP

Every Bash command, file edit, skill invocation, and MCP call is a span with a duration, and full input and output details.

Trace tool calls

Claude Code can query it back

The MCP server exposes your traces to the agent itself: it inspects last week’s runs, finds where tokens go, and edits its own workflow.

LangWatch MCP

Plot any analytics

Any metric on the trace can go on a chart: sessions running in parallel, cost per session, idle time while it waits on your reply.

Build a graph

Insights to improve your skills

Run Claude over your own trace history: what you asked for, what helped most, and the friction patterns where sessions go wrong.

Analyze your sessions

Questions

How do I track my Claude Code usage?

Run npx langwatch claude. It configures Claude Code’s native OpenTelemetry export to LangWatch. Every session lands as a trace: model turns, tool calls, tokens by class, and theoretical cost. ccusage-style local log readers see one machine; the OpenTelemetry route follows you across machines and survives local log cleanup.

Does it work with Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor, and Pi?

Yes. Each agent exports through the same OTLP endpoint, so everything lands in one store with the same token, cost, and trace treatment.

What does the "Bundled" cost label mean?

Sessions on a Claude subscription (Pro, Max, Team) have no per-token invoice. LangWatch marks those sessions Bundled and computes a theoretical total at API list prices, per token class. That is the number behind "what would this have cost on the API".

Are cached tokens counted?

Cache read and cache write are separate token classes on every span, priced at their own rates. In long agent sessions cache reads are most of the volume, so a tracker that lumps them into input gets both the total and the cost wrong.

What if I accidentally paste any secret keys on my Claude session?

API secrets are automatically redacted and never stored on the LangWatch side. PII is redacted the same way, so personal information does not end up in the trace. For tighter control, enterprise policies and self-hosted setups are available.

One command, then keep working.

Free for individual use. Setup docs

$npx langwatch claude

问题

如何跟踪我的克劳德代码使用情况？

运行 npx langwatch claude。 它将 Claude Code 的本机 OpenTelemetry 导出配置为 LangWatch。 每个会话都会作为跟踪记录：模型转换、工具调用、按类别划分的代币以及理论成本。 ccusage风格的本地日志读者看到的是一台机器； OpenTelemetry 路由会跟随您跨机器并在本地日志清理后继续存在。

它可以与 Codex、OpenCode、Copilot、Cursor 和 Pi 一起使用吗？

是的。 每个代理都通过相同的 OTLP 端点进行导出，因此所有内容都会以相同的令牌、成本和跟踪处理方式到达一个商店。

“捆绑”成本标签是什么意思？

Claude 订阅（Pro、Max、Team）上的会话没有每个代币的发票。 LangWatch 将这些会话标记为捆绑并按 API 标价计算每个代币类别的理论总数。 这就是“API 的成本是多少”背后的数字。

缓存的令牌是否被计算在内？

缓存读取和缓存写入在每个跨度上都是单独的令牌类，并按其自己的费率定价。 在长代理会话中，缓存读取占了大部分容量，因此将它们集中到输入中的跟踪器会导致总数和成本错误。

如果我不小心在 Claude 会话中粘贴了任何密钥怎么办？

API 机密会自动编辑，并且绝不会存储在 LangWatch 端。 PII 以同样的方式进行编辑，因此个人信息不会最终出现在跟踪中。 为了更严格的控制，可以使用企业策略和自托管设置。

一声令下，继续工作。
